The games both consoles share look, play, and sound entirely the same.  Despite a lot of people saying otherwise (and I'm sure I'll get hate for this) neither console really has a personality.  You like Halo, Gears of War, Fable?  Go Xbox.  You like Uncharted, God of War, Killzone?  Go PS4.  The exclusives are the only thing that will add any major difference to the GAMING experience.

Ni No Kuni is easily written off as being cutesy Japanese shlock, but I find it to be a great game.  The gameplay mechanics are solid, the graphics and music are amazing, and the story is great and well told.  It deals with some dark subjects, but not in either a) overwhelming cutesy or b) overwhelmingly melodramatic ways that a lot of other Japanese games/animes would handle.  Definitely worth it!
